name: Lucid Theme
description: Lucid: a light, readable theme for EspoCRM. Record view with an owner and pipeline band, collapsible blocks, adjustable columns and an activity stream, in two layouts (Split, fields beside activity, or Classic), three styles (Lucid, Monochrome, Brut), light and dark palettes and two densities, chosen from the top bar. Accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA / RGAA). https://github.com/AlexisSantin/espocrm-lucid-theme
author: Alexis SANTIN
